hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' | { read -r f; echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.ts$' && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -5; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' | { read -r f; echo "$f" | grep -q 'schema.prisma' && printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"schema.prisma 已修改。記得執行：(1) npm run db:migrate；(2) npm run db:generate。"}}'; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' | { read -r f; echo "$f" | grep -q 'domain/exception' && printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"新增了 domain/exception 檔案。記得在 GlobalExceptionFilter.ts 加上對應的 instanceof 分支 + HttpStatus + code。"}}'; } 2>/dev/null || true
